title: dendrolobium rugosum var. moniliferum
intro: Dendrolobium rugosum var. moniliferum, commonly known as Rough-seeded Dendrolobium, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities that help in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Rough-seeded Dendrolobium include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-bacterial agent, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
